name: RC-B10-0064/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Venezuela following the usurpation of the presidency on the 10th of January 2025
part_text:
The European Parliament says Nicolás Maduro has no right to be president of Venezuela. It says the July 2024 election was stolen and that Edmundo González Urrutia won and should have taken office on 10 January 2025. The Parliament asks the European Union to add Maduro and his close allies to its sanctions list, to press for the release of all political prisoners, and to support Venezuela's democratic forces. This is a statement of position, not a law.

- **What changes:** Nothing in law. Parliament states its position and calls for wider sanctions and freedom for political prisoners.
- **Who it affects:** Maduro, his inner circle and families, political prisoners, and Venezuelans in and outside the country.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to the Council, the Commission and other bodies. Whether sanctions grow is up to European Union governments.
